commands.text: Mera moves the lamp to the gate. The chalk marks beyond it are still where she left them.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: We withdraw before another name has to be added to the missing.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: Did we lose the whole route?

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: No. We lost this attempt. We know the way back in.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The record stays. Rest, change what you carry, and begin this part again.
